member.summary: Represents a set of schemes that must all apply (AND logic). A member with no credentials configured fails the call with before anything is applied; a member whose credential provider returns nothing ends the sequence with its unsatisfied .

member.name: T:SwaggerPetstoreOpenApi380.Core.Authentication.AuthScheme.AnyScheme
member.summary: Represents multiple alternative schemes (OR logic). Schemes with no credentials configured are not candidates and are skipped; the first configured scheme that applies wins. A scheme whose credential provider returns nothing is unsatisfied and skipped as well; a scheme that throws has failed, and once every candidate was tried the call throws carrying the failures and naming any unsatisfied scheme. With no failure and nothing applied, the unsatisfied schemes are returned as the for the engine to report, and with nothing configured at all the call throws naming the schemes it accepts.

member.name: T:SwaggerPetstoreOpenApi380.Core.Authentication.IRevocableAuthScheme
member.summary: Implemented by auth schemes that maintain cached credential state (e.g., an OAuth2 access token) which can become invalid before its natural expiry — for example, server-side revocation, suspicious-activity termination, or a scope policy change.
member.remarks:
When observes a 401 Unauthorized response on a request that used a revocable scheme, it calls with that request and then retries the request once, so the retry re-acquires a fresh credential instead of resending the rejected one.
The scheme drops its cached credential only when it is the one presented on the rejected request, and does so under its own lock: a credential issued after the rejected one is kept, and concurrent 401s for the same credential cost a single re-acquisition.
Composite schemes (AuthScheme.All, AuthScheme.Any, OrAnonymous()) implement this interface and propagate to every revocable inner scheme; only the inner scheme whose credential is on the request drops it.

member.name: T:System.Runtime.CompilerServices.ModuleInitializerAttribute
member.summary: Used to indicate to the compiler that a method should be called in its containing module's initializer.
member.remarks:
When one or more valid methods with this attribute are found in a compilation, the compiler will emit a module initializer which calls each of the attributed methods.
Certain requirements are imposed on any method targeted with this attribute: - The method must be `static`. - The method must be an ordinary member method, as opposed to a property accessor, constructor, local function, etc. - The method must be parameterless. - The method must return `void`. - The method must not be generic or be contained in a generic type. - The method's effective accessibility must be `internal` or `public`.
The specification for module initializers in the .NET runtime can be found here: https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/docs/design/specs/Ecma-335-Augments.md#module-initializer
